system.description:
Dutch Courage: a drink lowers your Fear Status by one step and gives +1 Talent Die on rolls to resist Fear effects for 2 hours. The Director decides how many drinks the bottle holds.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.158
system.summary: Dutch Courage: a drink lowers your Fear Status by one step and gives +1 Talent Die on rolls to resist Fear effects for 2 hours. The Director decides how many drinks the bottle holds.

when.label: Dutch Courage: you drank Liquor in the last 2 hours

automation.note: Each drink steps your Fear Status down once. For the next 2 in-game hours, tick the Dutch Courage bonus on Fear Checks. The Director sets how many drinks are left.
